entry.description: Default test entry (file or directory), relative to lxdev.json. Used when neither the preset nor the command line names one.

outputDir.description: Default --output-dir, relative to lxdev.json, unless the preset or the command line sets one.

openapi.description: Default --openapi document(s), relative to lxdev.json, unless the preset or the command line gives --openapi.

tags.description: Default --tag expression(s), unless the preset or the command line gives --tag.

presets.description: Named `lxdev test` argument lists for `--preset NAME`. The preset's arguments go after the defaults above and before the command line's: repeatable flags add up, a flag given later wins. No --secret-arg, --preset, --cancel-active, or credential-named --arg; keep secrets in a gitignored --secrets-file.
